speaker: Narrator
text: As their spacecraft touched down on the lands of Mars, the Astronaut and Nova descended together. A chaotic scene immediately greeted them; massive planetary billboards lay scattered and disorganized across the landscape.

speaker: Operator and Nova
text: Woah... what happened here?

speaker: Narrator
text: A bit weird that the planet in charge of marketing has their billboards all jumbled up like this.
Are you the kind souls sent by NETStart to help us?

speaker: Narrator
text: The pair turned to see a local resident approaching.

speaker: Mark
text: Greetings explorers! My name is Mark. I was told you were coming to restore our connection.

speaker: Operator
text: As a matter of fact, we are! I’m Operator, and this is my partner, Nova.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Astronaut replied, gesturing to the chaotic signage.

speaker: Operator
text: Could you please tell us what happened here? Must have been a rough day.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mark sighed, looking at the tangled mess.

speaker: Mark
text: When the solar storm hit, the billboards suddenly flickered before going completely blank! We haven’t figured out a solution for this problem yet. That darn solar storm caused some trouble for us all, I tell you!

speaker: Nova
text: You heard them! Let’s go investigate and find the problem.

title: Mini-Game 1A: Fix Name Billboard
objective: The player must use heading and paragraph tags to display the correct names and text on the blank billboard.

title: Mini-Game 1B: Fix Container Billboard
objective: The player must use division tags to properly group the scattered information blocks so they fit neatly on the screen.

speaker: Narrator
text: Once the billboard was restored, Mark prepared to leave with gratitude.

speaker: Mark
text: We’ll make sure you get proper compensation for your kindness.

speaker: Narrator
text: As they said their goodbyes and walked away, Nova summarized their findings.

speaker: Nova
text: So, Mark said a network shutdown caused the billboard blackout.

speaker: Narrator
text: Surveying the area, they noticed lingering atmospheric disturbances and unusual moisture on the ground, hinting at a recent storm.

speaker: Operator
text: Maybe the solar storm is what severed the connection to Mars.
You are exactly right!

speaker: Narrator
text: The pair turned to find two identical creatures standing nearby.

speaker: Emma G
text: My name is Emma G., and this is my twin, Penny G.

speaker: Narrator
text: The second creature gave a friendly wave.

speaker: Penny G
text: We both saw the storm knock the AstroLink offline. And with that, all our network connections went down too.

title: Mini-Game 2A: Fix Images Billboard
objective: The player must write the correct image tags and source attributes to restore the missing graphics on the billboard.

speaker: Penny G
text: Huh? That’s weird. Why isn’t the embedded video working?

speaker: Narrator
text: Penny G frowned in confusion as she stared at the billboard.

speaker: Operator
text: I believe it’s because the connection is still down.

speaker: Narrator
text: Nova nodded in agreement. The twins shared a look, scratching their heads in frustration.

speaker: Nova
text: Do you know where the AstroLink for Mars is located?

speaker: Emma G and Penny G
text: Sure, we can lead the way.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Astronaut carefully took the replacement parts out of their bag.

speaker: Operator
text: Let’s go back and fix the Billboard and the communication device.

title: Mini-Game 3A: Final AstroLink Repair
objective: The player must write the anchor tags and target the correct href URLs to establish a live network connection between Mars, Earth, and Venus, officially bringing the AstroLink back online.

speaker: Emma G and Penny G
text: Thank you for restoring our communication device, Operator and Nova!

speaker: Narrator
text: Looking around the illuminated plaza, the duo realized their mission on Mars was finally complete. Suddenly, the Astronaut’s communicator began to ring.

speaker: Oberion
text: Hello, Chief. Do you read me?

speaker: Operator
text: Yes, Sir. We just finished on Mars. The communication network is fully reconnected.

speaker: Oberion
text: Good work. Now, proceed to Venus.
